findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_supplier · Private data: search_suppliers, get_supplier, list_facets · Public sink: list_facets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_supplier · Private data: search_suppliers, get_supplier, list_facets · Public sink: list_facets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
